sara (eng-runtime): FYI rolled a lightweight feature to the canary pool: adaptive-KV-eviction + regional-fallback routing. Seeing promising early wins, sharing quick summary and next steps. :rocket:

noah (perf): nice — quick numbers? p50/p95/cost?

sara (eng-runtime): short summary from the canary (3h):
- cost/unit (tokens) down ~17% on small-gen workloads (chat preview flows)
- overall throughput +6% when eviction fires on long conversations
- p50 reduced by ~12ms, p95 roughly flat (+2ms)
- tail improved for multi-region requests due to fallback routing avoiding cold hosts

li (bench): raw numbers from the dashboard snapshot (UTC):
```
canary = c-runner-14
window = 3h
requests = 48k
cost_delta = -16.7%
lat_p50 = -12ms
lat_p95 = +2ms
embeddings_cost_delta = -9% (less batching efficiency but net win)
```

sara (eng-runtime): short explainer of what we changed:
- adaptive-KV-eviction: when total KV size for a model shard crosses dynamic threshold (based on recent prefix lengths) we evict least-recently-used spans earlier, freeing memory for hot prefixes and keeping batch sizes high.
- regional-fallback routing: if a request sees >2 second scheduling delay in primary region, route to warmed compatible replica in secondary region with same model variant. avoids long stalls on cold hosts.

mike (sre): deploy-bot shows the canary rollout succeeded, any errors logged?

deploy-bot: canary-rollout/2181723456 -> SUCCESS (8:31 UTC). 0 critical errors, 12 warnings (kv-evict misses).

li (bench): one thing to call out: embeddings workload showed less batching due to earlier evictions, so unit cost for long embedding runs is slightly worse; net is still +cost win overall because generation workloads dominate request mix. We should monitor embedding-heavy tenants.

sara (eng-runtime): agreed — plan: ramp canary -> 10% prod traj every 2 hours if signals stable. Will push a feature-flag to exclude known embedding-heavy routes for first ramp.

noah (perf): can you post the kpi dashboard link and the alert thresholds you want to gate the ramp?

sara (eng-runtime): dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/kv-evict/adaptive-2181723456
Gate checks (every 15m window):
- overall error rate <= 0.1%
- p95 latency regression <= +20% vs baseline
- cost/unit <= +5% (for embedding-specific tenant group)

mike (sre): @oncall-team please watch anomalies on scheduling delay and cross-region egress during the ramp. If we see >3% increase in cross-region egress persistently, pause.

kate (ceo): awesome work — big thanks to runtime & perf teams. please include a 1-slide summary for tomorrow's all-hands. :tada: 

sara (eng-runtime): will do. tagging @product for FYI (we may update the public perf notes if numbers hold).

noah (perf): adding a short postmortem template to the doc once we finish 24h. If anything weird pops up I'll open an incident thread.

sara (eng-runtime): thanks — monitoring/telemetry owners: @li, @noah. Rolling schedule pinned in the runbook. Will update here with 6h and 24h snapshots.
